review_basis: The three independently reviewed and approved 2026-07-25 design specifications
The earlier zeroxB product design and implementation roadmap
Current credential, canvas-tab, chat-sync, export, index and HUD source paths
Writing-plans task structure and ADworkflo medium-risk review checklist

initial_findings.title: Credential migration omitted shared native and provider request paths
initial_findings.resolution: Task 19 now covers the JavaScript config/settings UI, tauri-client, chat, embedding, rerank, OCR/VLM, model checks, TTS/STT and Rust ai.rs path. JavaScript stores and sends only opaque credential/header references; Rust resolves and attaches secret values.

initial_findings.title: ViewportSnapshot lacked container origin and stable point conversion
initial_findings.resolution: Task 1 now captures containerLeft/containerTop, defines screenPointToCanvas, cancels invalid-container operations and tests last-valid per-field fallbacks.

initial_findings.title: Permanent-canvas plan omitted legacy canvas-tab producers and restoration
initial_findings.resolution: Task 7 now includes canvas sidebar/startup/tab utilities, article store and EditorLayout activation effects, with a persisted canvas-tab migration.

initial_findings.title: Index mutation/worker lifecycle was missing and overlay recall preceded its dependency
initial_findings.resolution: Task 15 now establishes the tested job/index contract, authoritative save enqueue, revision deduplication, retries, startup resume, deletion/rebuild and candidate-query interface before overlay recall.

initial_findings.title: Canvas chat context conflicted with the local-only sync boundary
initial_findings.resolution: Task 10 now classifies canvasContext as local-only, strips it from all chat sync/backup payloads and ignores remote context during restore.

initial_findings.title: Existing visible export actions were not removed
initial_findings.resolution: New Task 18 removes Windows-visible file/config/theme/backup export actions and adds a reachability contract while preserving internal thumbnail/print/recovery primitives.

initial_findings.title: Geometry cancellation events were unplanned
initial_findings.resolution: Task 5 now handles pointercancel, lostpointercapture and window blur for draw/resize/move with latest-authority restoration and no history.

initial_findings.title: HUD drafts and long-history segmented rendering were missing
initial_findings.resolution: Task 12 now owns session-only per-conversation/per-canvas drafts and defines measurable 40-message segmentation with a 10,000-message rendering contract.

initial_findings.title: Security and AI policy thresholds were not deterministic
initial_findings.resolution: Tasks 14-16 now define large-movement confirmation thresholds, 0.85/0.60 confidence bands and a fail-closed loopback/no-proxy raw-sensitive-context policy.

suggested_tests: Execute the plan task-by-task with the listed failing-first tests and commit gates.
Repeat independent review after implementation using the final L2 impact report and Windows installer evidence.
risk_notes: The independent first pass found one Critical and eight Important gaps; every finding was converted into exact files, interfaces, constants and tests in commit 393b2c1b.
The resolution audit found no remaining placeholder or implementation-blocking ambiguity in the reviewed areas.
This task changes planning/workflow artifacts only; no runtime behavior has been implemented or tested.
Implementation remains a large multi-phase effort and requires task-scoped L2 preflight, post-edit impact reports and independent review at the release gate.
